scope: Qualified Hildebrand1994Theorem1 expected random-support mixing for every fixed k=d+1>=2 and every fixed strictly positive normalized finite label PMF. The actual recursively defined iid walk and genuine uniform law on all ordered injective supports are used, not a conditional surrogate. Positive gamma and N are derived before prime modulus/support, exact time floor(gamma*p^(2/d)), all sufficiently large primes and every start have actual expected halfL1<epsilon. Full support pointmass and first-point/relative-injective-sample expectation decomposition proved; actual support-coordinate independence is never assumed. Standard frequency indexing onto every complex additive character derived. Actual finite Gaussian moment and mean-square TV bounds, weighted Cauchy, falling-factorial denominator limit, fourth-power estimate and exact real-power/floor controls derive the source exponent. Actual zero-weight pure-label walk is deterministic, actual full-support expected distance>=1/2 for all prime moduli/times/starts and no gamma/threshold can give<1/4: strict-weight-deletion negation over unbounded primes, not qualified source refutation. Prior literal intermediate Gaussian/k2 counting errors retain their valid repairs and author correction credit. Standard foundations/default settings, no holes/custom axioms/native evaluation/raised limits/global flags/waivers/native experiment/spend/upload. Static rho/collision penalty/limiting constants and original fourteen-item gaps remain open. No novelty/absence/canonical-corpus promotion claim.
